title: Recall: Reuse default methods and override selectively
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

default.clue: Inside trait Caption with required fn label(&self) -> &str, write the complete default caption method returning String via format! with the positional pattern "[{}]" and self.label() as its argument.

override.clue: Inside impl Caption for Loud, write the complete overriding caption method returning the owned uppercase version of self.label() using to_uppercase.
